corridors.name: Guwahati–Shillong demonstration corridor
corridors.village_impact_note: Connects Assam state capital Guwahati to Meghalaya state capital Shillong; disruption affects cross-state commerce, patient referral, and district-level administration.

corridors.name: Siliguri–Gangtok demonstration corridor
corridors.village_impact_note: Only national highway linking Sikkim to the rest of India; blockage isolates the entire state from surface supply chains and emergency response.

corridors.name: Imphal–Churachandpur demonstration corridor
corridors.village_impact_note: Links Manipur capital Imphal to Churachandpur; blockage cuts access to southern Manipur hill districts and cross-border supply routes.

corridors.name: Aizawl–Lunglei demonstration corridor
corridors.village_impact_note: Primary state highway connecting Aizawl to Lunglei district; blockage affects southern Mizoram district headquarters and village supply access.

corridors.name: Kohima–Mokokchung demonstration corridor
corridors.village_impact_note: Key Nagaland corridor; blockage disrupts Mokokchung district access and the road link to northern Nagaland towns.

corridors.name: Guwahati–Tezpur–Itanagar demonstration corridor
corridors.village_impact_note: Connects Assam to Arunachal Pradesh capital Itanagar; blockage disrupts state capital access and cross-state traffic including strategic supply routes.

corridors.name: Dimapur–Kohima demonstration corridor
corridors.village_impact_note: Connects Nagaland's main railhead Dimapur to state capital Kohima; blockage disrupts all rail-linked surface supply to the state capital.

corridors.name: Agartala–Udaipur demonstration corridor
corridors.village_impact_note: Links Tripura capital Agartala to Udaipur; blockage disrupts southern Tripura district administration and supply access.

corridors.name: Shillong–Jowai demonstration corridor
corridors.village_impact_note: Connects Meghalaya capital Shillong to Jowai (Jaintia Hills district); blockage affects eastern Meghalaya district connectivity.

corridors.name: Tinsukia–Dibrugarh demonstration corridor
corridors.village_impact_note: Connects eastern Assam's major towns Tinsukia and Dibrugarh; blockage disrupts Upper Assam oil-region commerce and district hospital access.

corridors.name: Gangtok–Mangan–Chungthang demonstration corridor
corridors.village_impact_note: Connects Sikkim capital Gangtok to North Sikkim district headquarters; blockage cuts off northern Sikkim villages including high-altitude communities.

corridors.name: Imphal–Ukhrul demonstration corridor
corridors.village_impact_note: Links Manipur capital Imphal to Ukhrul district; blockage isolates Ukhrul hill district from capital and affects road-dependent supply and medical referral.
